categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Yuanchen Environmental Protection Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the environmental protection sector focusing on the research, production, and sales of new materials including filtration materials, denitrification catalysts, and PTFE micro-powders. The company also provides environmental testing services covering air, soil, and water. Its core product lines include dust filtration materials and SCR denitrification catalysts, serving industries such as power generation, steel, cement, waste incineration, chemical, and new energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as ultra-clean electrostatic bag asymmetric gradient technology, electret treatment, PTFE composite emulsion membrane technology, and integrated dust removal and denitrification technology. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including customized order-based production, strict quality control following TQM standards, and integrates intelligent environmental island solutions using AI, edge computing, and digital twin technologies. The R&D system is project-based with pre-research and embedded process stages to ensure product quality and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major industrial enterprises and national groups such as State Power Investment Corporation, Longjing Environmental Protection, Everbright Environment, Huashu Co., Anfeng Steel, China Resources Cement, and Sinopec. The company serves primarily the power, steel, cement, waste incineration, chemical, and new energy industries, providing products and intelligent environmental management solutions tailored to these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Hefei, Anhui Province. It has established overseas offices and agents targeting markets in Europe, East Asia, Southeast Asia, the Arab region, and countries along the Belt and Road Initiative. The company is actively expanding its international footprint with plans to shift from offshore exports to nearshore and onshore production to better serve global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Yuanchen operates primarily in the midstream segment of the environmental protection supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of core filtration materials and catalysts. It also extends upstream into third-party environmental testing services and downstream into intelligent environmental operation and maintenance services, offering integrated 'product + service' solutions to industrial clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes deepening its core environmental protection materials business, enhancing market share in key industrial segments, and expanding its 'product + service' integrated ecological offerings aligned with China's dual carbon strategy. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on advanced filtration materials, low-temperature denitrification catalysts, and AI-driven intelligent environmental island technologies. The company also emphasizes international market expansion and the digital transformation of environmental management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized filtration materials and denitrification catalysts to industrial clients. The company also earns income from third-party environmental testing services and intelligent environmental operation and maintenance services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, tenders, and negotiated contracts, with a focus on long-term service contracts and integrated solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong brand recognition in the industrial flue gas treatment sector, ranking among the top five in the domestic high-temperature filtration materials market and top three nationally in SCR denitrification catalysts for steel sintering. It competes in a fragmented, highly competitive market with low industry concentration, maintaining competitive advantages through technological innovation, product quality, and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 629.7 million, a 20.11% increase year-over-year, but recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 60.86 million, reflecting intensified market competition and increased costs. Total assets stood at RMB 1.265 billion with a slight decline from the previous year. The company continues to invest about 5.88% of revenue in R&D, supporting steady technological advancement despite profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui Yuanchen emphasizes its proprietary advanced filtration and denitrification technologies that enable ultra-low emissions and high efficiency under harsh industrial conditions. Its integrated intelligent environmental island solutions combine hardware and AI-driven software for optimized pollution control and operational efficiency. The company offers comprehensive lifecycle management and customized solutions, differentiating itself through high product quality, strong R&D capabilities, and a full-service approach aligned with environmental regulations and carbon reduction goals.
